description: Gen OBF from OSM (hand-made): 'Lidl espoo' with the map centered in Vantaa. The bbox of Espoo covers western Vantaa (3 Lidls) and a Lidl of Nurmijärvi (place=town, Klaukkala); Espoo has 2 Lidls near its centre, 4 on its eastern edge (15-20 km from the user, 6-8.5 km from the centre) and 4 objects at one spot in Niittykumpu (supermarket, charging station, office, parcel locker). Vantaa and Nurmijärvi (a town ranks as a city) lie in their own boundaries (tag groups), so they go below every Lidl of Espoo. Among Espoo's own, the eastern edge comes before the centre, and the Niittykumpu spot takes 4 rows of the first screen
